description.value: Lotus Inn Restaurant is a family-run Chinese and Cantonese restaurant that has been a Kamloops institution since 1971, with its current ownership in place since 1995. The menu spans over 60 dishes — from soups and curry to seafood and Szechuan cuisine — anchored by a popular all-you-can-eat buffet. The restaurant is fully licensed, wheelchair accessible, and features large private dining rooms capable of hosting events for up to 350 guests.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at lotusinnrestaurant.ca is fully accessible and provides comprehensive business details including address (512 Tranquille Rd, Kamloops, BC V2B 3H4), phone (250-376-2611), and service options. Takeout is explicitly confirmed by the website; wheelchair accessibility and free parking are also stated on the contact page. No mention of bike racks, water refill for cyclists, or washrooms appears anywhere in the website content, so those required criteria remain null.
concerns: OSM name is 'Lotus Inn' but the business consistently presents itself as 'Lotus Inn Restaurant' on its website.
OSM record carries no address and no phone number; both fields sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed fields cannot be validated against OSM.
Washrooms not explicitly mentioned on website despite being a full-service dine-in restaurant — a human reviewer could likely confirm in person.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established, active restaurant with confirmed takeout service that would be useful to touring cyclists, but none of the three required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from website content.
